scope: WP2 offline contract/DOM/Fetch doubles; not browser or paid API validation

checks.name: valid persisted list and public detail accept real integer artifact versions
missing persisted step/output remains null without synthesizing a state
explicitly incomplete malformed event is visible without inferred timestamp
wrong source, invalid pagination and invented task type are rejected
duplicate task and unknown Agent identifiers are rejected
malformed output and human confirmation metadata do not silently become confirmed
asset viewer links must match exact saved asset and same local origin
source URLs reject scripts, credentials and signed secret query parameters
list uses one GET with encoded exact filters, no payload and no cache
detail uses one bounded GET and checks response task identity
invalid history IDs and local query parameters never send requests
API failure never reflects server exception paths or secrets into the UI
404 is a clear history missing error with no automatic task recreation
network error makes only one request and permits explicit later recovery
invalid JSON and structurally invalid responses are reported accurately
timeout cancels the local read and does not retry or call execution routes
history initializes idle without automatic reads or active workflow restoration
manual form lists persisted task and populates only actual saved state choices
list pagination keeps committed filters and remains a separate manual read
empty history state does not synthesize demo records
manual list error can be recovered by another user query
detail displays real saved JSON, citations, review and human record without accept controls
running record is explicitly a non-live snapshot without fake progress
untrusted markup stays literal text and no executable nodes are created
very long saved output is folded and bounded with an explicit non-mutating truncation note
asset links refer only to exact saved realistic asset and never pretend another style model exists
unlinked history never invents a role or GLB relationship
model provenance labels distinguish saved real generation from local fixtures and unknown imports
missing detail displays explicit failure and manual read recovery action
older list response cannot overwrite the latest user query
older selected detail cannot overwrite another task or reappear after new list query
event pagination is user initiated and keeps selected historical task
history HTML entry and main initialization preserve old module chain and 8-page navigation
history module source contains no mutation methods, timers, SSE, local storage or HTML injection
